children.name: Switch between light and dark appearance
At least one gauge stays on. Order is set on the Accounts page.
Which screen edge the notch is on. Default: Right.
Alt-drag the notch to slide it along its edge, or towards another edge to dock there.
One notch on the main display, or one per display. Default: Main display.
Which display the notch follows. Default: Follow active window.
Always shown, a pill that opens on hover, or hidden. Hidden does not stop toasts. Default: Always show.

Turns off Pulse's toasts and alert sounds; cards that answer something you did, or that need an answer, still show. With Show set to Hidden, or the notch folded for a full-screen app, a toast brings the notch out and it goes again. Default: on.
Folds away when a full-screen app is in front. Default: on.
Puts the notch back in the middle of its edge.
Small, medium or large. A stored choice is kept; only an install that never chose gets the default.
A scale instead of the size presets. Default: off.
How large the notch is, from 0.5 to 1.5. Default: 1.00×.
Glass or solid material. Default: Glass.

The gear at the end of the notch, with its update and permission dots. Off hides it; Settings stays reachable by clicking a ring, from the hub's sidebar, and with the Open Settings shortcut. Default: on.
Holding Alt and dragging slides the notch along its edge. Off leaves the Edge row and Reset position; the grip beside the gear still moves it. Default: on.
The card that opens when the pointer rests on a ring. The Tools buttons and the Send device list live on those cards; the middle-click wheel still offers the tools. Default: on.
Prints the use percentage under each ring. Default: off.
Where the second (weekly) reading is drawn. Default: Inside.
Draws the second ring dashed. Default: off.
Makes the weekly limit the main ring. Default: on.
Adds the second reading to the text under a ring. Default: off.
Claude's main ring shows today's share of the week. Default: off.
Shows whether use is ahead of or behind an even pace. Default: off.
Spark and code-review windows on Codex's hover card. Default: on.
How reset times read. Default: Automatic.
Colour for positive use and active work. Default: Green.
Hard step or smooth ramp between colour bands. Default: Hard step.
Where a ring turns orange, as a share of the limit. Default: 70%.
Where a ring turns red, as a share of the limit. Default: 90%.
Language of the notch's own text. Default: Follow System.
